seo.title: About David Sandoval — Software Engineer
seo.description: How David Sandoval works across backend-oriented product engineering, frontend delivery, debugging, validation, developer tooling and software-maintenance research.

summary: Backend-oriented Software Engineer with hands-on frontend experience. I connect technical decisions to business context, trace assumptions across system boundaries and validate changes before treating them as solved.
biography: I’m a backend-oriented Software Engineer with hands-on frontend experience across .NET, Angular and TypeScript. I enjoy the part of engineering that starts before the fix: understanding the behavior, the business rule behind it and the boundaries a change can affect.

At Atena, I work on existing fintech software rather than isolated greenfield exercises. That has taught me to trace assumptions through callers and services, make authorization and data contracts explicit, use tests and type-system feedback to find affected behavior, and revise my own conclusion when new evidence changes the problem.

Outside work, I build developer tools and product projects, and I’m developing my thesis around vulnerable-dependency remediation in OSS ecosystems. The research direction changed after the literature challenged my first framing; keeping that correction visible matters to me because learning should change the plan when the evidence changes.
focusAreas: Maintainable backend systems and API boundaries
Automated testing and CI quality gates
availabilityStatement: Open to remote software engineering opportunities, including international relocation or graduate study as part of ongoing career growth.
researchSummary: Researching whether upstream maintenance signals add useful prospective information for estimating vulnerable-dependency remediation latency; the final outcome definition and model family remain under validation.
currentRoleSummary: I currently work at Atena as a Jr. Software Engineer. My work is backend-oriented with significant frontend scope, with a focus on correctness, authorization, service integration, debugging and validation in existing fintech systems.
